01 /Profile
FRANÇOIS DE GENNARO · MONS, BE

Networks first. Curiosity everywhere.

Understanding what’s under the hood.

I’m in the second year of a bachelor’s degree in computer science at IPHLF in Mons. My direction: networking, system administration and infrastructure, with an interest in automation.

I like tracing a problem back to its underlying mechanism: reading a configuration, following an exchange, isolating a cause. Linux is my personal environment too, not just a classroom topic.

Java and SQL have taught me to structure applications and their data. During my internship, I want to bring that combination of infrastructure and development to a team.

EducationBachelor’s in computer science · year 2
FocusNetworks · Systems · Infrastructure
